en: Black‑and‑white view down a very narrow alley lined with tall, old multi‑story houses. Each building has stacked wrought‑iron balconies overflowing with laundry hanging out to dry and some potted plants. The architecture is dense and irregular, with stucco and stone walls and tiled roofs. In the background are steep, rocky mountains, suggesting a town built in a valley or on a hillside. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
